name: Trigonometric Inequality Projection
description: Replaces the explicit binary inequality p_u != p_v with a trigonometric product condition cos(pi * p_u) * cos(pi * p_v) < 0. Since p_i is in {1, 2}, this evaluates to (-1) * 1 < 0, exactly enforcing opposite assignments. Models relying on explicit inequality checks or standard graph text patterns will fail to recognize the bipartite structure.
